description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different data sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—across varying numbers of tokens, with the x-axis representing the "Number of Tokens" on a linear scale ranging from 200 to 900 in increments of 200, and the y-axis showing a metric (likely performance or accuracy) from 10 to 40. The "Tutorials" data, represented by a blue line with circular markers, starts at approximately 23 at 200 tokens, increases to about 28 at 500 tokens, and then slightly decreases to around 29 at 800 tokens. The "Library Documentation" data, shown in red with circular markers, begins at approximately 26 at 200 tokens, rises to about 32 at 800 tokens, and then declines to around 28 at 900 tokens. The "StackOverflow posts" data, depicted in yellow with circular markers, starts at approximately 33 at 200 tokens, decreases steadily to about 19 at 800 tokens, and then drops further to around 12 at 900 tokens. The "Github files" data, represented by a green line with circular markers, starts at approximately 28 at 200 tokens, increases to about 33 at 800 tokens, and then slightly decreases to around 30 at 900 tokens.
